id: title:dmarchuk:attribute run metrics and conversions to a version

review.posthog_relevance: Adds workflow version attribution to HogFlow invocation and email tracking, preserving the version of the workflow that actually sent the message rather than the currently published version. This supports PostHog's ability to diagnose delivery and conversion issues and attribute metrics to specific workflow versions.
review.reason: The chunk contains substantive implementation changes across account and person HogFlow invocations, the HogFlowExecutorService, EmailTrackingService, and SES webhook handling. These hunks demonstrate the addition of workflow version parameters and their propagation through the invocation and tracking pipeline, establishing a bounded capability for versioned attribution.
